Package org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery

Class Page<T>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery.Page<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The row type.
public final class Page<T> extends Object
One page of query results, plus the optional counts selected by the session's CountPolicy.
  • total(): rows that pass the guards (before the search).
  • matched(): rows that pass the guards and the search.

Under CountPolicy.NONE neither count is present. Under CountPolicy.MATCHED only matched() is. Under CountPolicy.BOTH both are. Counts are opt-in and independent of each other: a caller that did not ask for a count gets an empty OptionalLong back rather than an exception, so "was a count computed" and "read the count" are the same call.

Example:

Page<Person> page = session.find(BeanQuery.create().counts(CountRequest.BOTH).build()); for (Person p : page.rows()) render(p); page.total().ifPresent(total -> renderFooter(page.matched().getAsLong() + " of " + total));

Since:
10.0.0
